title: Reorganizar el lienzo de Gentle Design
brief: Reorganize the Gentle Design canvas UI for users with basic computer knowledge, keeping advanced power behind options. Goals from the UX review: a steps indicator «1 Comparar · 2 Revisar · 3 Elegir · 4 Implementar» with the current step marked (the Implementing band becomes step 4); three review tabs (Comentarios with an open/resolved filter, Calidad, Mezcla) with Historial and Encargo under «Más»; «Implementar» only inside a proposal in focus, a single «Abrir» in the overview; a skippable three-step first run; a clear offline notice at the top with what to do; overview = compare, inside the proposal = review with «Comentar» and «Añadir a la mezcla»; a «Detalles técnicos» toggle off by default; plain words («Propuestas», «Accesible ✓», «Petición original», «Guardar para enviar luego»). Every existing canvas feature stays reachable. Content: the «Uso» screen of Mission Control.

artboards.title: Pasos que guían
artboards.tradeoff: The steps bar drives the whole screen and each step shows only its tools: the clearest path for a first-time user, but more clicks to jump between comparing and reviewing, and a fixed footer that costs vertical space

artboards.title: Galería y sala de revisión
artboards.tradeoff: A calm gallery to compare and a review room that holds comments, quality and mix in one side panel: the least crowded overview, but it drops the free pan-and-zoom canvas, so side-by-side detail and the minimap only live inside the room

artboards.title: Lienzo progresivo
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps today's canvas layout, trimmed to three tabs plus Más, labeled tools, a compact step breadcrumb and first-run coach marks: the smallest change for current users, but the canvas metaphor (pan, zoom, rail) still asks beginners to learn more
